digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow — macOS pytest temporary storage
propositions: An APFS RAM disk experiment was designed to store pytest temporary Git repositories on macOS CI to reduce filesystem I/O latency, following precedent from Apple Git CI and Aeron; the no-RAM control baseline measured macOS default suite at 17m26s and job at 20m36s.

Four independent RAM-disk treatment runs (31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, 31873067707) all measured slower than the no-RAM control, ranging 18m26s–20m54s for the same suite, failing to meet the predeclared ≥5% improvement retention threshold.

The experiment exposed two separate defects: intentionally owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot fixtures caused PermissionError during recursive cleanup, and nested pytest inherited cacheprovider state causing isolation leaks; both were repaired.
The RAM-disk lifecycle and contract tests were removed and reverted; both pytest tiers now use runner.temp unchanged, with distinct default and integration basetemps preserved.

Static workflow contract tests and existing CI consumers (test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_extra_coverage_guard.py, test_worktree_python_pin.py) remained unchanged; selectors, markers, xdist workers, timeouts, coverage, and platform matrix are unmodified.

Merged change 1806 (commit 7d908fbbc6da12f8e274b3ef1e3a2357377799ef) restored production to no-RAM state; final run 31873067707 passed all suites and cleanup paths, confirming the revert is safe and complete.
